name: Rinjin wa Hentai Chijo ~Anata ga Shiranai Ano Ko no Seiheki~
original_name: 隣人は変態痴女 ～あなたが知らないあの娘の性癖～
source:
“Huh? Who sent me this?” muttered Tsunaki Eiji as he received an email.
“If you go to the convenience store now, you'll be able to see Hironaka Kotona's secret kink.”
He found his neighbor's name written in it.

That's the landlady's daughter, Hironaka Kotona.

She's a cheerful girl who greets me normally.
What's it with her secret kink?
Who sent me this anyway? I don't remember ever seeing this email address.

So what should I do?
After some worrying, Eiji went to the convenience store.
Even since he witnessed the absurd scene there, his environment started becoming more and more lewd…

translation:
“嗯？这是谁发来的？”纲木映司收到邮件后喃喃自语。

“现在去便利店，你就能看到弘中琴菜的秘密性癖。”

邮件里写着邻居的名字。

那是房东的女儿，弘中琴菜。

她是个开朗的女孩，平时会自然地和我打招呼。
她究竟有什么秘密性癖？
这封邮件又是谁发来的？我不记得见过这个邮箱地址。

我该怎么办？

犹豫一番后，映司去了便利店。

自从目睹那里发生的荒唐场面后，他周围的环境开始变得越来越淫乱……
